def min_time_to_deliver_employees(n, employees):
    from collections import deque

    # Initialize the elevator position and time
    elevator_position = 1
    time = 0
    # Use deque to maintain the order of employees
    current_queue = deque()

    for i in range(n):
        current_floor, destination_floor = employees[i]
        # Add the employee to the current queue
        current_queue.append((current_floor, destination_floor))
        # Move the elevator to the current floor
        time += abs(elevator_position - current_floor)
        elevator_position = current_floor
        # Open the doors and let people in/out
        while current_queue and current_queue[0][1] == elevator_position:
            _, destination_floor = current_queue.popleft()
            time += 1  # Time to get out
        # Load the elevator with the remaining employees
        while current_queue and len(current_queue) + len(current_queue) <= 4:
            current_floor, destination_floor = current_queue.popleft()
            time += 1  # Time to get in
            time += abs(elevator_position - current_floor)
            elevator_position = current_floor
            time += 1  # Time to get out

    # Move the elevator back to the first floor if not already there
    while elevator_position != 1:
        time += 1
        elevator_position -= 1

    return time
